description: create-skill-autoresearch: the kill guard blocks pattern kills (pkill, killall, pgrep-fed kill) in Bash calls, so stop owned jobs with scripts/run_owned.py, denies Monitor and sleep or poll loops while a build job it owns runs (with the command that blocks on it), gives each call to this skill's scripts or a build's work/evaluation/*.sh a 600000 ms foreground timeout (updatedInput), and (as the loop guard) a build's Phase 4 metric run once scripts/check_gate.py --loop says the loop is done; the read guard denies reading this skill's script and hook source (each script's --help says how to run it) and a second whole read of a factory reference in one context (again after a compaction), in a Read or a shell call; the subagent guard denies a background Agent dispatch inside a factory build (a headless session stops background subagents 10 minutes after its last turn), so researchers and panel roles run in the foreground; the finish guard sends a factory build back when the main session's turn ends (never a subagent's) while scripts/check_gate.py --finish fails, at most max_finish_sendbacks times per build
